== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7)]] (<code>1273_27</code>), showing the '''original''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-01-Master_Kenobi.png]]) prints PC-E1 ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-masterkenobi-pre.gif]]) PC-E3 ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]]).

* '''Text source:''' Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet as first published (official text as of 3 June 2011); no copy of that printing has been found, so the text is the 23 June 2011 errata text (Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT”, [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]) without “[Maintenance] cards or”, which that post says the errata added. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''original text:''' “While ‘communing’: you may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may place one just forfeited in Used Pile; Once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan’s Hut).”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1273_27</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block set mark, copyright line, no errata mark (the first printing predates the errata)) with the original game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-01-Master_Kenobi-original-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B12 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
